lines.t: In this game you are human by day, and a vampire by night.
The Blood of Dawnwalker gives you 30 days and nights to rescue your family from a vampire lord.
It's set in the Carpathian mountains, during the Black Death.

sc.label: A real Carpathian castle
sc.credit: Hunyad Castle, Romania. Photo: Luke.ender, public domain

lines.t: It sold a million copies in three days, and peaked at 78,000 players on Steam.
It was made by the director of The Witcher 3, who paid for the first prototype himself.

sc.sub: he paid for the first prototype

lines.t: The twist: exploring is free, but every quest costs you time.
Day, or night? Follow for more!
